_comment: OPTIONAL editorial layer, keyed by module/app name or package, merged OVER the autoloaded manifest. Every fact (title, version, icon, description, signer) is read from index.json automatically — this file only exists for things a manifest can't know. All keys optional; delete this file entirely and the catalog still renders. Supported keys per entry: featured (bool, floats to top), bucket (string, overrides the category grouping), blurb (string, longer copy than the manifest description), homepage (string, links the title), repo/source (string, → a 'Source' link), docs (string, → a 'Docs' link), website (string, → a 'Website' link). Basecamp module manifests carry NO repo URL, so add repo here to expose source; F-Droid apps already expose sourceCode/webSite and get Source/Website links automatically.

delivery_module.blurb: Shared Waku delivery node — our fork with SDS Reliable Channels enabled. A backend dependency (no UI of its own); other modules ride it for sync.
